lines.trans: Ah, a comfortable wooden bench in the shade: my feet completely approve of the fourth clue!
Listen to the final rhyme: "Sit in the shade and bring all four corners home together."
Bring all four corners together... hand me cards one, two, and three, Claire!
Wait: look at the faint blue lines drawn on the back along the edge of each card!
Let's flip them flat on the bench slat like four tiles of one single square...
One top left, two top right, three bottom left, four bottom right!
Incredible! Together, the backs of the four cards form a bird's-eye view of the Hotel du Tilleul!
There is our courtyard linden tree, and there are the arched windows of Room 9...
And look up on the upstairs wooden courtyard balcony: a bright red star!
Why did the mapmaker paint a red star on our upstairs courtyard balcony?!
Perhaps the small wax-sealed envelope in your pocket has the answer, Claire!

words.gloss: wax ('cire d'abeille' = beeswax; 'sceau de cire' = wax seal)

examples.text: Cette jolie rime rend la chanson facile à retenir.
examples.trans: That pretty rhyme makes the song easy to remember.

meanings.note: Marqué en rouge = marked in red. Descriptive French adjective meaning 'red'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Les jours sont marqués en rouge.
examples.trans: The days are marked in red.

examples.text: Une voiture rouge.
examples.trans: A red car.

examples.text: Ma valise! J'ouvre la poche du haut... oui, mon ruban rouge!
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, my red ribbon!

meanings.note: Spoken or written reply to a question, letter, or riddle.

examples.text: La réponse à l'énigme se trouve juste devant nos yeux!
examples.trans: The answer to the riddle is right in front of our eyes!

examples.text: Elle attend une réponse par le courrier de demain.
examples.trans: She is waiting for a reply in tomorrow's mail.

related.gloss: question; matter (pas question = out of the question)

meanings.note: To gather people or scattered pieces back together ('se réunir' = meet, gather).

examples.text: Réunissez les quatre cartes bord à bord sur la table.
examples.trans: Bring the four cards together edge to edge on the table.

examples.text: La fête du tilleul réunit tout le quartier chaque été.
examples.trans: The linden festival brings the whole neighborhood together every summer.

meanings.note: Reflexive verb.
Polite imperative.

examples.text: Asseyez-vous, s'il vous plaît.
examples.trans: Have a seat, please.

examples.text: Assieds-toi là.
examples.trans: Sit there.

meanings.note: To seal an envelope with wax or seal a stone box shut; figuratively to seal a pact.

examples.text: L'enveloppe était scellée à la cire rouge depuis trente ans.
examples.trans: The envelope had been sealed with red wax for thirty years.

examples.text: Une poignée de main chaleureuse vient sceller leur accord.
examples.trans: A warm handshake seals their agreement.

meanings.note: For following a person or route.
Figuratively, for following and understanding what someone is saying.

examples.text: Tu me suis?
examples.trans: Do you follow me?

examples.text: Suivez-moi, s'il vous plaît.
examples.trans: Follow me, please.

examples.text: Le vieux bureau clair sous les toits... suivez-moi, vite!
examples.trans: The old bright attic study... follow me, quickly!

meanings.note: Sur la table, sur la route.
Sur haut-parleur = on speaker.

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

examples.text: Tu es sur haut-parleur.
examples.trans: You're on speaker.

meanings.note: For a late time or doing something late.

meanings.en: à plus tard = see you later
meanings.note: With plus, later; à plus tard is the farewell see you later.

examples.text: Il est tard.
examples.trans: It's late.

examples.text: Je rentre tard.
examples.trans: I'm getting home late.

examples.text: Trop tard! Il a dit merci et il a raccroché!
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

meanings.note: Fragrant courtyard shade tree; also herbal tea.

examples.text: Sur la cour, juste au-dessus du vieux tilleul. C'est très calme.
examples.trans: The courtyard, right above the old linden tree. It is very quiet.

examples.text: Bienvenue à l'Hôtel du Tilleul, Claire. Votre deuxième jour ne sera pas ennuyeux.
examples.trans: Welcome to the Hotel du Tilleul, Claire. Your second day will not be boring.

examples.text: Hôtel du Tilleul, bonjour! Claire à l'appareil.
examples.trans: Hotel du Tilleul, good morning! Claire speaking.

meanings.note: Entirely, wholly.

examples.text: L'intérieur de la boîte est resté totalement sec.
examples.trans: The inside of the box stayed completely dry.

examples.text: J'avais totalement oublié l'existence de ce passage!
examples.trans: I had completely forgotten that this passageway existed!

meanings.note: To draw crisp lines, letters, or a route; for sunlight to cast shadows.

examples.text: À midi, les aiguilles tracent une ligne verticale parfaite.
examples.trans: At noon, the clock hands form a perfect vertical line.

examples.text: Elle a tracé le plan du jardin à l'encre de Chine.
examples.trans: She drew the garden plan in India ink.

examples.text: Trois semaines.
examples.trans: Three weeks.

examples.text: Trois cafés.
examples.trans: Three coffees.

meanings.note: indefinite article; des in the plural
Number; l'un = one of them.

examples.text: Et voilà la cloche du portail. Un coup franc.
examples.trans: There goes the gate bell. One firm ring.

examples.text: Voilà un taxi devant le portail à l'instant.
examples.trans: Here comes a taxi in front of the gate right now.

meanings.note: French relational/descriptive adjective derived from Latin adjectival roots.

examples.text: Je vous adresse mes plus vifs remerciements.
examples.trans: I send you my warmest thanks.

examples.text: Une vive émotion traverse la pièce.
examples.trans: A keen emotion runs through the room.

examples.text: Le grand frère était vif et bruyant, toujours pressé de finir ses gammes.
examples.trans: The older brother was lively and loud, always in a hurry to finish his scales.

voilà.gloss: there is; here's; there you go

meanings.note: To present something.

examples.text: Voilà exactement le contrat que je cherchais depuis ce matin!
examples.trans: Here is the exact contract I have been looking for since this morning!

examples.text: Nous voilà enfin arrivés devant le grand hôtel.
examples.trans: Here we are at last in front of the grand hotel.

meanings.note: Polite or plural 'you'.

examples.text: Votre nom?
examples.trans: Your name?

examples.text: Laissez vos photos ici.
examples.trans: Leave your photos here.

meanings.note: Une belle vue.

examples.text: La chambre a une vue sur la mer.
examples.trans: The room has a view of the sea.

examples.text: Oui, un bon lit en bois, un bureau propre et la meilleure vue de la maison.
examples.trans: Yes, a good wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the house.

examples.text: Comment est ma cravate aujourd'hui, Claire? Zéro goutte de jus d'orange en vue!
examples.trans: How is my tie today, Claire? Zero drops of orange juice in sight!

meanings.note: Place: à Paris, à mon cours.
Time: à midi.

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
meanings.note: Contractions.

examples.text: Je suis à Paris.
examples.trans: I'm in Paris.

examples.text: À quatorze heures.
examples.trans: At two pm.

meanings.note: No preposition.

meanings.en: écoute = listen, look (to start a point)
meanings.note: Casual imperative.

examples.text: Écoute, c'est difficile.
examples.trans: Listen, it's difficult.

examples.text: J'écoute la radio.
examples.trans: I'm listening to the radio.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le étage', plural 'les étages') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'floor'.

examples.text: Le bureau est au troisième étage.
examples.trans: The office is on the third floor.

examples.text: Allez, le premier arrivé au troisième étage!
examples.trans: Come on, race you to the third floor!

examples.text: Vraiment? Les étages en plus ne vous dérangent pas?
examples.trans: Really? The extra floors do not bother you?

meanings.note: De petites étoiles = little stars.
Une étoile du cinéma.

examples.text: Regarde les étoiles.
examples.trans: Look at the stars.

examples.text: Bravo, ma nouvelle grande étoile!
examples.trans: Bravo, my new big star!

examples.text: Il va écrire un avis terrible d'une étoile!
examples.trans: He is going to write a terrible one-star review!
